why: Removes the empty-slot guard, so New Game asks for a whole new session WHILE one is running -- on top of the in-session New Game the slot also receives. Two runs from one click, and the second discards the first's world mid-frame. Silent in a browser: the screen ends up on a level-one board either way, which is what the click asked for. 1 of 25 -- 'none of the three asks for a session while one is attached', the only case that asserts the request seam stays EMPTY with a session live. Its siblings all drive an empty host and keep passing, which is what makes this a real two-way discrimination rather than a restatement of them.
